messages:
Maria Chen: FYI — Alex from Acme escalated. They started seeing 400 errors: "InvalidEmbeddingDimension" after we enabled dynamic batching for embeddings last night. Also seeing tail latency spikes around 800ms -> 2s. Customer says this started after they deployed a model swap.

Alex (customer): I'm sending 2 texts in a single client batch. Some requests return 1536-d vectors, others 768-d. When the error happens the API returns 400 and no embeddings. Repro steps: send 2 inputs quickly, sometimes fails.

Devin Patel: Can you paste the exact request you used (headers + body)? and which model names?

Alex (customer): Here's a minimal repro curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"text-embed-lite","input":["short text","another text"]}'
```

Alex (customer): In prod they sometimes send mixed traffic; one client instance still hits `text-embed-ada-002` and another `text-embed-lite`. We assume our runtime will batch them.

Maria Chen: Thanks — that matches the histogram: during the incident we see batches combining requests targeting different embedding models. Server logs show: `ERROR InvalidEmbeddingDimension: expected 1536 got 768 for request_id=req_4b2c`. Snippet from logs: 

```
2026-02-10T22:13:02Z ERROR embed_worker.cpp:217 request=req_4b2c batch_id=867 model=text-embed-ada-002 produced_dim=768 expected_dim=1536 InvalidEmbeddingDimension
```
Devin Patel: Hmm — dynamic batching should include the model and model-version in the batching key. If it didn't, two model variants could be combined and the post-batch validation fails. Do we have a change that altered the key set?

Simon (infra-oncall): I rolled a tweak to the batching key last night to reduce key cardinality (PR #4529) — we removed `model_revision` from the key to increase batch hit rate. That was intended for text-gen endpoints. Looks like embeddings require strict model-identifiers because dims vary. Rolling back now.

Support Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-87. Notifying infra and runtime teams.

Devin Patel: Workaround for customer: set `max_batch_size: 1` or pin a single model per client to avoid mixing; also set `batching_key: model` if your SDK supports it. Can we provide a quick cURL test to confirm?

Maria Chen: Sent the workaround — asked customer to try `{"model":"text-embed-ada-002","input":["x"]}` single-model batches.

Alex (customer): Confirmed — setting client to pin the model eliminated the 400s in their short test. Tail latency lowers too. Thanks.

Devin Patel: Root cause summary I suggest we use for the ticket: dynamic batching key was made too permissive to increase batch formation across variants; for embeddings this allowed requests for models with different output dims to coalesce, leading to post-inference validation failures and retries that increased tail latency.

Simon (infra-oncall): Mitigation deployed: reverted PR #4529 on staging and prod; added a runtime guard to refuse to batch across `model` or `model_revision` differences for embedding-capable routes. Observed immediate drop in 400s.

Maria Chen: Customer notified and confirmed resolution in prod (no more 400s after our rollback). They also reported tail p50/p95 improved. :thumbsup:

Devin Patel: Action items:
- [ ] Runtime: add model-aware batching keys for all embedding routes and add a unit test to assert no mixed-dim batches (owner: infra-runtime, ticket INC-2026-87).
- [ ] SDK: expose `batching_enforce_model: true` toggle and docs (owner: devex).
- [ ] Support: email Acme with RCA and mitigation steps + recommended client config (owner: Maria).

Simon (infra-oncall): Note: we'll also push a guard that validates `expected_dim` against model catalog before releasing batch. If mismatch, we drop the offending request with a clearer 422 error instead of 400 — avoid opaque dimension errors.

Maria Chen: I'll draft the customer note and include repro steps and the curl example plus recommended short-term config: `max_batch_size: 8` + `model_pin: true` until updates are live.

Alex (customer): Appreciate the quick help. Please add a note if you want me to roll a client-side change across our fleet.

Devin Patel: Good catch by infra. Leaving this open until runtime tests + SDK toggle are shipped. Closing the immediate incident as mitigated.

Support Bot: Incident INC-2026-87 status -> mitigated.

Maria Chen: Marking follow-ups in the ticket. Will attach logs and the `InvalidEmbeddingDimension` stack trace.

Simon (infra-oncall): Follow-up PR will include: batching key fix, unit tests, and a small perf bench to ensure batch hit rate doesn't regress badly for text-gen. Posting ETA: 48h for PR, 1 week for full rollout.

Devin Patel: Thanks team. If anyone sees recurrence ping me and include `req_*` ids.

Maria Chen: Closing thread for now — will reopen if customer reports further issues. :white_check_mark:
